notes.title: Every Day's Different Is Officially Released!
notes.content:
After 3 years of development, Every Day's Different is Officially on Steam!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176466/4645bd9fe7fe40a843bf235cb88c919e5027ba1b.png[/img]

Every Day’s Different Started Development on Wednesday, November 14th, 2018 with some really crappy character drawings and depression. I’ve grown tremendously as an artist and a person while working on EDD. It’s crazy how much has changed since then! EDD has been the longest and hardest Project I’ve ever worked on in my life. Getting to create games, stories and characters is all I’ve ever wanted for my future path. EDD has given me the confidence to finally be happy in life. Whether it succeeds or fails, I'm so proud of myself and my wonderful Team.



I really hope you all enjoy what we have poured so much love into; this Visual Novel is for you<3


With love,


Jesse North

Snowfall Studio

notes.title: Delayed.
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

For the past couple months we’ve been ahead of schedule, making huge strides in progress to complete Every Day’s Different. All that needs to be completed is the programming and final testing!


Unfortunately this year has hit us with another blow, Our programmer/co-creator has had a family emergency come up that will require his full attention for the next undetermined amount of time. We’ve decided to pause production until later this year. We can’t give a specific date as of yet, but I will be sure to keep updating as often as possible. Until then I will be working on finishing all the backer's rewards, be sure to send us a message if your physical address has changed.

To make it up to you, here is some new art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176466/72ef0fe0bcfa3d65529aaa3a4b32976633b8fd80.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176466/76ece04eed964a34f8f1807422e0a331f53ce418.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176466/24ec07b6cabf2d8462e8904f6f974377fb73f19a.png[/img]


I want to thank everyone for their continued support through all these delays. The discord community has been wonderful. It gives me an immense amount of joy to see EDD this close to being completed, we’ve really put our heart into it and I hope that shows.



We encourage you to join us in donating whatever you can spare.
https://www.braintumour.ca/ways-to-give/donate-now/


With Love,
Snowfall Studio

notes.title: Update Patch / Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello Steam! 

You may have noticed that Every Day's Different had an update last night, this is our first patch. We've updated a couple sprites as well as some background art to better reflect the writing. The intro of the game has also been re-written. I hope you enjoy!

We also have an official release date! Instead of continuing to break it into episodes, we have decided to release the rest of the game all at once! The final script has 200K words, and we can't wait to share the whole story with everyone!

[u][b]Every Day's Different Releases Aug 6th![/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176466/8529725f084c17c5b24716af4fbc60853b0da943.png[/img]

notes.title: Episode 2 Out now!
notes.content:
Episode 2 is now out!! 

Be sure to leave any feedback you have. This episode took much longer than it should have; we ran into quite a few complications during Episode 2, and alongside COVID it took much longer than we would have liked. We do not expect future episodes to take this long and are aiming for ~2 months between each one. We are ahead on things for Episode 3, and are planning to be done the game fully by summer of next year at the latest. Thanks everyone for sticking things out with us and we hope you enjoy Episode 2!


-Snowfall Studio

notes.title: Episode 1 Out Now!
notes.content:
Every Day's Different Episode 1 is now playable for all! We're happy to release the first episode of the Visual Novel we have been working on the past year. It's been quite the learning experience and we're so happy to share it with everyone!

As it is early access, please don't hesitate to give us feedback for future episodes, I hope everyone is staying safe and sane.
